'''Gaffer Gamgee The Court is Ready for Battle!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaffer Gamgee]]
* '''Published:''' 3 January 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile Gamgee DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Court of the Vile Gangster updated and more battle oriented based on the comments to my previous deck.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ok...first off, thanks for your comments on my previous deck. I think these changes will make it more powerful.

Turn 1: Pull the Tatooine docking bay with the objective. Pull Mighty Jabba with Audience Chamber. Deploy for 3. Pull Rodian (V) with Jabba's Influence. Deploy for 2.

Turn 2: Pull Spaceport docking bay. Ideally drop it wherever opponent has set up shop. Pull Lyn Me using Jabba's Influence. Deploy her for 2. Pull Boba Fett (V) using Rodian (V). Deploy him for free using Lyn Me. Pull Boelo (or Ephont Mon) using Power of the Hutt.

On subsequent turns continue pulling an alien with Jabba's Influence and the rest of "Jabba's Crew" using Power of the Hutt.

I think this deck is now much stronger and more focused. I toned down the capturing a bit and am focusing more on winning battles. I kept a bit of the capturing side theme if the opportunity presents itself. Note: I still need to acquire a copy of Mara Jade and Jodo Kast.
